title: Goal extraction reads the rescope banner instead of the defect
body:
> **Rescoped to Phase 1 only.** This issue originally carried eleven acceptance criteria, which is over the six-AC limit the ship harness enforces, so discovery split it. Phases 2 and 3 were filed as their own issues and must land in order. Sub-issues: #201 (Phase 2), #203 (Phase 3). Do not re-expand this issue.

The goal parser takes the first paragraph of the issue body verbatim, so a banner prepended above the problem statement is read as the problem statement.

## Success Criteria
- [ ] SC-1: the banner is skipped
